> Clean by construction: an ordinary comparison. Near-miss for the binary
> contrast family — "we chose X over Y" is a stated preference, not a
> rhetorical inversion.

We chose the managed queue over running our own broker. The managed one costs
about nine hundred a month at current volume and the self-hosted one costs
roughly a third of that in machines plus whatever the on-call time is worth.

At our size the on-call time is worth more than six hundred a month, so the
managed queue wins. At ten times the volume that arithmetic reverses and we
should revisit it.
